description:
Offline encyclopedia for programming diagnostics and runtime errors.

LexiconError is a local-first desktop encyclopedia for compiler diagnostics, linter rules, runtime exceptions, configuration failures, and GPU runtime faults. It provides full-text offline search, structured root-cause guidance, trigger-versus-fix examples, situational context, and cross-language mappings.
First stable desktop release with 16,474 locally searchable diagnostic records, interactive root-cause and frequency analysis, code comparisons, provenance, cross-language mappings, SQLite FTS5 search, and portable catalog utilities.
